relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: the NGF (0.5, 2.5 and 5 ng/mL) upregulated ACAN, Col-II, and Sox9 in a dose-dependent manner

relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results demonstrated that NGF could bind to its high-affinity receptor TRKA, subsequently activating downstream PI3K/AKT signaling in chondrocytes.

relationships.subject: GNF5837
relationships.evidence_quote: GNF5837 significantly reversed the upregulation of ACAN, Col-II, and Sox9 proteins compared to the 5 ng/mL NGF group

relationships.subject: LY294002
relationships.evidence_quote: NGF increased the expression of ACAN, Col-II, and Sox9 (P = 0.0073, 0.0005, and 0.0112, respectively, Fig. 5A-D), which was significantly reversed by LY294002

key_findings: NGF at 0.5-5 ng/mL promotes chondrocyte ECM synthesis (ACAN, Col-II, Sox9) via TRKA and PI3K/AKT
